Model MAE
How many points the model misses a final margin by, on average. Lower is better.
Market
The same measure for the closing betting line. It is the benchmark, and has not yet been beaten.
Brier skill
How much better its win probabilities are than always guessing the base rate. Zero would mean it knows nothing beyond how often home teams win.
Calib err
How far its stated confidence sits from what happens. Under 2% means a 70% call really does win about 70% of the time.
